Calculate small vortex positions

coords_to_vortex_coords.Rd

Vortex is a small 2x2 field, where objects rotate. The function takes coordinates of the points and potential offset, and calculates new columns:

Usage

coords_to_vortex_coords(moment, offset, settings)

Arguments

moment

Position tibble with integer x and y columns.

offset

Vector of two numbers (x and y) by which the vortex grid is shifted.

settings

List with basic properties. Currently not used.

Value

moment with extra columns vx, vy and pos.

Details

  • vx, vy: coordinates of the vortex the object belongs to

  • pos: position of the object within the vortex, one of "SW", "SE", "NW", "NE"

NOTE: object coordinates (and vortex coordinates vy) assume the y-axis has positive values upwards (like a chart, not like a screen).
